text: The Lattice Converter is the [Harmonic Energizer](pulse_adapter) turned around: feed it Forge Energy (FE) from another mod's generators or cables and it beats that energy into Pulse for your camp.
It is not a fair trade. Raw FE is noise to a lattice, and it takes totem voices to make it hold.

pages.title: Setting it up
text: Run FE into any face. The Converter buffers **48,000 FE** and never gives FE back out.

Each second it makes up to **40 Pulse** and puts it into Pulse stores within **8 blocks**: Pulse Cairns, totem buffers, gate keystones and other Pulse stores first, then generators with room to spare. If nothing nearby has room, it waits and spends no FE.
Each [rank](machine_ranks) makes more Pulse a second.

pages.title: Voices make it cheaper
text: With no voices around, one Pulse costs **220 FE**. Every distinct **Answered** Resonance Totem voice within 8 blocks takes **20 FE** off, down to **120 FE** at five voices. Kinship Totems do not count here.
Pulse to FE and back always loses some: the Energizer turns one Pulse into 100 FE, and the Converter never takes less than 120 FE to make one.

pages.title: When nothing flows
text: A redstone signal pauses it, and it takes no FE while paused. A comparator reads how full its FE buffer is.
Right-click it for a status line. Crouch and right-click it with this book to see its buffer, its price per Pulse and what it made last second.

pages.text: Needs a Resonant Core from Echo Manifest and two Attuned Echoes from Echo Attune.
